docs.text:
Daily digest of newly added, removed, and modified aconfig feature flags in AOSP.

Latest snapshot — 2026-04-14T09:38:15Z · 2625 flags across 243 files

No reports yet. The first daily scan will populate this page.

docs.title: How this works
docs.text: Every day a GitHub Actions runner shallow-clones a curated set of AOSP projects, parses every *.aconfig file, and diffs the result against yesterday's snapshot. Security-adjacent flags (by namespace, path, or description keywords) are highlighted in their own section so they're easy to skim.
